source: Manually curated -- standard DMD clinical trial endpoints/biomarkers, general knowledge
note: SEED DATA -- needs periodic re-verification. These are the endpoints referenced throughout DMD trial design (see each item's primary_outcomes fields in data/raw/trials_dmd.json) and regulatory guidance (see data/raw/regulatory_guidance_dmd.json, especially FDA-DMD-2018 and FDA-EXPEDITED-2014). Definitions are general clinical-trial-methodology knowledge, not pulled from a live structured API -- recheck against a current source before treating as authoritative.

items.name: Dystrophin protein expression
items.description: Quantifies dystrophin protein restored in muscle fibers after treatment. The accepted surrogate endpoint underlying accelerated approval of exon-skipping antisense oligonucleotides (eteplirsen, golodirsen, viltolarsen, casimersen) and micro-dystrophin gene therapy (delandistrogene moxeparvovec).

items.name: Serum creatine kinase (CK)
items.description: Elevated CK reflects ongoing muscle membrane damage/leakage and is markedly elevated in DMD from birth, often used for early diagnosis and monitoring, though it correlates poorly with disease severity/progression stage.
items.used_in: Diagnosis, natural-history monitoring; rarely a primary trial endpoint

items.name: North Star Ambulatory Assessment (NSAA)
items.measured_via: 17-item observational rating scale of ambulatory motor function
items.description: The most widely used ambulatory-function outcome measure in DMD trials, scoring activities like standing, walking, and climbing stairs. Central to recent non-surrogate-endpoint approvals (e.g. givinostat/Duvyzat).

items.name: 6-Minute Walk Test (6MWT)
items.description: A standard ambulatory-function endpoint measuring walking distance/endurance; widely used as a primary or key secondary endpoint across DMD and other neuromuscular disease trials.

items.name: Forced Vital Capacity (FVC) / pulmonary function
items.description: Tracks respiratory muscle decline, which becomes the dominant clinical concern once ambulation is lost. Used as a primary or key secondary endpoint in later-stage/non-ambulatory DMD trials.

items.name: Muscle MRI fat fraction
items.description: Quantifies fatty/fibrotic replacement of muscle tissue, a sensitive marker of disease progression that can detect change before functional decline is apparent -- increasingly used as a supportive/exploratory endpoint.

items.name: Performance of Upper Limb (PUL)
items.measured_via: Observational rating scale of upper-limb function (shoulder/elbow/wrist-hand dimensions)
items.description: The standard upper-limb function measure for DMD, particularly important once ambulatory measures (NSAA/6MWT) are no longer applicable in non-ambulatory patients.

items.name: Timed function tests (e.g. time to rise from floor, 4-stair climb)
items.description: A family of simple timed tasks (supine-to-stand, 4-stair climb, 10-meter walk/run) used as secondary endpoints and to track ambulatory decline; the Gowers' sign (using arms to push off the floor to stand) is a classic early DMD diagnostic observation from this same task family.
